meta.title: About
meta.description: Ofogh Zamin manufactures and supplies precision brass fittings and fluid-system components — built to recognised standards for reliable, leak-tight service.

hero.title: About Ofogh Zamin
hero.subtitle: Since 1976, Ofogh Zamin has designed, machined and supplied brass fittings and valves for water, gas and fluid systems — engineered for reliable, leak-tight performance.

story.title: Who we are
body: Since 1976, Ofogh Zamin has worked in the manufacture of brass valves and fittings, drawing on years of experience and expertise to deliver products that are high in quality, durable and matched to the needs of diverse industries. Building on technical knowledge, specialist experience and precise production and quality-control processes, the company has consistently advanced the quality and development of its products.

At Ofogh Zamin, we see quality as the sum of many factors — from selecting a standard, high-grade brass alloy and quality raw materials, to precise design, sound manufacturing and continuous quality control at every stage. The result is products with high corrosion resistance, long life and durability, and dependable performance.

With the capability to produce a diverse range of brass valves, fittings and components, Ofogh Zamin serves many different projects and industries, and can manufacture products tailored to customers' specifications and requirements.

Our commitment is not limited to producing quality products; customer satisfaction, fast delivery, product variety, adherence to quality standards and reliable service are all an inseparable part of how we work.

Backed by experience, specialist knowledge and a capable team, we at Ofogh Zamin always look to the future — striving, through continuous product development and higher production standards, to make a meaningful contribution to the progress of the industry and to the needs of the market.
Ofogh Zamin — quality you can trust.
